company_setup.title: Company Setup Wizard
company_setup.subtitle: Configure a new company from profile to a working configuration, end to end
company_setup.create_company.description: Register the new company's legal details. It will become your active company for the rest of this wizard.
company_setup.define_profile.description: Tell the system about this company's size and needs so it can determine the right configuration.
company_setup.profile.growth_notes_place: e.g. expand to more branches, add new sales channels...
company_setup.profile.capability_gap_not: Point-of-sale count and Departments are not yet supported by the system core and are intentionally left out of this form rather than guessed at — they will appear as capability gaps in the Blueprint if relevant.
company_setup.review_profile.description: This is what was recorded for this company.
company_setup.sizing.description: The Sizing Engine scores this company across 8 dimensions using deterministic, versioned rules — never a single Small/Medium/Large label.
company_setup.generate_blueprint.descrip: Generates a draft set of recommendations from this company's profile and sizing result. Generating never changes any business data.
company_setup.review_blueprint.descripti: Every recommendation is classified and explained — nothing here has been applied yet.
company_setup.approve.description: Approving is a deliberate, explicit step — the system never approves a blueprint on its own.
company_setup.review_plan.description: A Configuration Plan lists exactly what will and will not be applied.
company_setup.plan.gap_note: Only the decisions already proven safe to auto-apply become plan items; everything else stays a recorded recommendation, never guessed at.
company_setup.validate.description: Validation re-checks the source blueprint is still approved before anything can be applied.
company_setup.apply.description: Applies only the actionable decisions. Re-running Apply is always safe and never creates duplicates.
